BiblicalUsage: Tidal is a king of nations who joined Chedorlaomer in the war against the kings of the plain. In Genesis 14:1, it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar. The fuller story is told on the Tidal profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that Tidal is named at all, which tells me God sees individuals, not only crowds.
